Ava (sec-eng): @Jenn — following up on the evidence request from this morning. Can you confirm exact artifacts for RBAC and KMS you need for the prod org?
Jenn (auditor): Hi — prod org rw-prod, 12 months of RBAC changes, full KMS rotation and decrypt usage for aliases alias/redwood-*. Also sample IR playbook linking a privileged role change to alerts.
Ava (sec-eng): We'll prepare: git change history (signed SHAs), CI/CD deploy logs, CloudTrail IAM & KMS events, k8s rolebinding snapshots, KMS key metadata (rotation status), and the IR playbook with screenshots.
Kai (infra): KMS exports live in s3://redwood-evidence/kms-metadata/2024-*/ — I can produce a JSON bundle. Want CSV mapping too?
Jenn (auditor): JSON bundle preferred, plus a CSV control mapping table (control_id -> artifact path). We need control IDs linked to SOC2/ISO controls.
Ava (sec-eng): We'll include control_map.csv and control_map.json. Example map row: "SOC2-CC6.1","s3://redwood-evidence/kms-metadata/key-rotation-2024.json","kms-rotation-log","rotation event + alias mapping"
Marcus (oncall): FYI there was an emergency service-account rotation on 2024-07-11 that required manual approval. I'll annotate that in the timeline and attach the incident ticket.
Jenn (auditor): Mark exceptions clearly. RBAC diffs need signed commit SHAs and deployment timestamps.
Ava (sec-eng): Commit example we'll include: - commit: 5f3a2b7 - pipeline: infra-prod-rbac - deployed_at: 2024-07-11T15:22:03Z. We'll attach CI logs.
Kai (infra): CloudTrail queries used: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue="kms.amazonaws.com" --start-time 2023-03-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z > kms-events.json. And similar for IAM role events.
Jenn (auditor): Include a Splunk/CloudWatch example so we can re-run checks.
Kai (infra): Splunk example: index=cloudtrail source=aws_cloudtrail eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, resources
Ava (sec-eng): k8s audit snapshots path: s3://redwood-evidence/k8s-audit/2024-*/rbac-snapshots.tar.gz. Each snapshot will have kubectl output + a digest file.
Jenn (auditor): Provide SHA256 manifests and a short verification procedure.
Ava (sec-eng): Manifest example: file: rbcsnapshot-2024-07-11.tar.gz, sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855, verifier: sha256sum rbcsnapshot-2024-07-11.tar.gz
Marcus (oncall): OpsBot created ticket RW-EVID-402 for the bundle. @OpsBot attach draft link?
OpsBot: Ticket RW-EVID-402 created: https://tickets.redwood/internal/RW-EVID-402. Draft staged at s3://redwood-evidence/drafts/RW-EVID-402/ (presigned link expires in 7 days).
Ava (sec-eng): Also including vuln-triage.md for a stale high-privilege role we found and mitigation timeline. For encrypted artifacts we'll list key alias and decrypt audit (who/when).
Jenn (auditor): For decrypt audit include key_id, alias, decrypt events, and IAM principal ARNs. Link decrypts to deployments or IR actions.
Kai (infra): We'll add a CSV: key_alias,key_id,rotate_enabled,rotation_dates,decrypt_count,last_decrypt_at,sample_principals. Sample row: "alias/redwood-secrets-prod","1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab","true","[2022-08-01,2023-08-01,2024-08-01]","42","2024-11-10T04:12:09Z","arn:aws:sts::111111111:assumed-role/redwood-app/instance-1234"
Jenn (auditor): Good. Last item: annotate third-party managed services and which controls are vendor-owned.
Ava (sec-eng): We'll add third_party_controls.md listing SaaS DB, log ingestion, monitoring, and ownership.
Marcus (oncall): ETA: full bundle + control_map by EOD tomorrow. Follow-up sync after review?
Jenn (auditor): EOD works. We'll review and flag gaps. Thanks.
Ava (sec-eng): Thanks — ping me for urgent items. :thumbsup:
